summary: Completed testing for Iteration 194 - Payment Methods CRUD and WhatsApp Wallet Notification Templates. Backend: All 14 API tests PASSED (8 payment methods CRUD tests + 5 notification tests + 1 seeded data verification). Frontend: Payment Methods page (/payment-methods) loads correctly showing seeded UPI (rahul@ybl) and Card (****4567 Visa) methods. Add Payment modal works with UPI/Card toggle, validation correctly rejects UPI without @ sign. Card form has all required fields (last4, network Visa/MC/RuPay, holder, expiry). Patient Profile shows Payment Methods menu item with blue gradient icon. Theme uses dark background and Outfit font consistently.

issues: IntroScreen overlay (z-[99999]) blocks interactions when navigating within app. This is existing behavior mentioned in iteration 193. Not blocking direct URL navigation to /payment-methods or /patient-profile.
